newsitem.title: TAIWAN: Taiwan dollar rises on foreign fund influx.
newsitem.headline: Taiwan dollar rises on foreign fund influx.

text.p: The Taiwan dollar edged higher in early Tuesday trade on an influx of foreign equity funds, dealers said.
After 30 minutes, the local dollar was at T$27.426 against Monday's T$27.442 close. Turnover through dealers was an active US$68 million.

The weakness of the U.S. dollar overseas also triggered some U.S. dollar sales in early trading, but dealers expected a stable session with demand for the local unit easing ahead of Friday's Chinese Lunar New Year holiday in Taiwan.

"U.S. dollar buying will start to emerge as the Taiwan dollar demand for the (Lunar) New Year is slowing and many people expect the local unit to depreciate after the New Year (holiday)," said one dealer at a foreign bank.
A range of T$27.42-45 was seen for today.
